name: sightkick
description: Compile a sightmap corpus and tool layer into a runtime-agnostic IR (WebMCP, CLI, or Playwright), and run it on arbitrary sites.

scripts.regen: pnpm regen:runtime && pnpm regen:skills && pnpm regen:inspector
scripts.regen:runtime: pnpm --filter @sightkick/runtime build && cd generator && go generate ./runtimebundle/...
